mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 65 degrees at Verona Community Park, with a waning crescent moon visible.

In city news, the Verona Police Department announced an arrest regarding an incident reported on Sunday, August 30, 2026, involving a school staff member. Also, construction for the Aldi development begins the week of September 7, bringing traffic shifts near Highway M, and the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is underway with bridge work causing detours.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department confirmed that a 34-year-old Madison resident was arrested on Friday, September 4, 2026, for an incident involving a school staff member that was reported on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
